Belém — Lisbon, Portugal

🟡 Local press research

Average day Relatively safer night

In detail

Belém's own parish president is on record calling it "one of Lisbon's safest areas," and no night-time crime pattern turned up in press searches. However, organised pickpocket rings targeting tourists near the monuments are documented: Notícias ao Minuto (8 Aug 2025) reported the pretrial detention of five pickpockets who used coordinated blocking tactics and a card-reader device to rob a tourist near Praça do Império/Padrão dos Descobrimentos, part of a broader pattern of "sophisticated" pickpocket gangs working the Belém monument area. Sources checked: Notícias ao Minuto, 8 Aug 2025 – "Preventiva para 5 carteiristas que atuavam com 'sofisticação' em Belém"; Observador, special report on Lisbon problem areas – parish president quoted: "Belém tem sido sempre uma das zonas mais seguras de Lisboa".

Frequently asked questions

Is Belém safe?

Wandroz currently rates Belém in Lisbon, Portugal as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Lisbon, Portugal during the day and relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Lisbon, Portugal at night. This comes from Wandroz's Level 2 approach: genuine, dated local/national press research for this specific area — not blind guessing, and not a fabricated statistic — but honestly disclosed as press-based rather than an official geolocated crime dataset, since none is publicly available for Lisbon, Portugal at this level of detail. See the methodology page for what was checked and the sources used.

Is Belém safe at night?

At night, Belém is rated as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Lisbon, Portugal, based on the same press research. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Belém a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Belém's day rating (roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Lisbon, Portugal) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late.
